title: Beautiful Totem Of Undying
description: This is a resource pack on adding a 3D model for the totem of unduying. But in the inventory and in the hot bar there is a 2D texture
body:
![CvldyLogo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dee5d0395adea0b3ef703ad1fd61e34ad431f1e0.png)
 # Beautiful Totem Of Undying
This resource pack changes the appearance of the Totem of Undying, making it look like the totem from Actions & Stuff. Nothing extra—just the model!                    
**BUT**! The "**Beautiful Totem Of Undying**" and "**_More_ Beautiful Totem Of Undying**" resource packs have now been merged into a single one — this one. I was finally able to recover my Modrinth account!!!!   
The resource pack comes in two versions: **Basic** and **WOutline**. The Basic version has ~~no outlines~~, while WOutline includes them.

> _Recommended mods_    
> 
> If you are using the WOulines version - [Simply No Shading](https://modrinth.com/mod/simply-no-shading)     
> First-person animations - [Hold My Items](https://modrinth.com/mod/hold-my-items) or [Punchy!](https://modrinth.com/mod/punchy-fpa)
